title: Ajeet Kumar v. State of U.P.
disposition: Writ disposed; petitioner directed to CGRF under cl. 7.10
headnote: The High Court declined to direct the District Consumer Protection Forum, Sonebhadra to decide a pending tariff-billing complaint and relegated the consumer to the Consumer Grievances Redressal Forum under Clause 7.10 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, with a 15-day filing / 8-week disposal direction. Reconnection was left to a request before the officer, to be decided in accordance with law.
facts: Ajeet Kumar alleged that his rural electricity connection at Sonebhadra was billed on an inflated tariff. He filed Complaint Application No. 76 of 2011 before the District Consumer Protection Forum, Sonebhadra, and also represented to the Executive Engineer seeking bill correction and a stop on excess recovery. Alleging non-cooperation before the Forum, he sought a High Court direction for early disposal of that complaint. The Power Corporation said the grievance lay before the CGRF under Clause 7.10 of the 2005 Supply Code, the Sonebhadra forum being attended at Mirzapur.

holding_units.topic: CGRF route for tariff and billing grievance
holding_units.holding: A grievance as to the rate of tariff and alleged excess billing is to be placed before the Consumer Grievances Redressal Forum constituted under Clause 7.10 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The High Court will not mandamus the District Consumer Protection Forum to decide such a complaint; the consumer is to approach the functioning CGRF (here Mirzapur, looking after Sonebhadra) with a certified copy of the order, for time-bound disposal.

not_decided.point: Merits of the tariff and alleged excess billing
not_decided.note: Whether the connection was rural and whether the bills were at the wrong rate was not examined.
Left open to a request before the officer, to be decided in accordance with law.
